verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's docs say users can opt out of the model improvement program self-serve from the dashboard, which directly lets them stop their data being used for training. An older community post notes the privacy policy allowed customer audio to be used "for training purposes"; that describes the default posture, not a failure of the opt-out, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the opt-out covers (all data types, retroactive effect, streaming vs. async), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: opt out of the model improvement program, set a time-to-live for audio and transcripts, and sign a BAA, all self-serve from the dashboard.
